description: An Employee Relations Manager must decide how to relaunch a paused cross-team case-review forum and finalize its facilitation, participant-input method, and initial duration.

shared_context.S1: The monthly cross-team case-review forum has been paused after participants raised concerns about how discussions were handled.
shared_context.S2: The forum is intended to resume this quarter so teams can share case lessons and coordinate responses.
shared_context.S3: Leah has authority to approve the relaunch structure, facilitator, and participation process.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal relaunch process, Leah holds a short check-in with each regular participant before finalizing the forum plan.

PF1.text: Tom personally saw the current forum chair copy a participant's confidential case comment into a team chat last month; the participant asked Tom not to raise it until the scheduled relaunch review, so Leah has not heard about it.

PF2.text: Nadia agreed with several quieter participants that the first two resumed sessions would accept anonymous written questions in advance, because those participants do not feel safe raising sensitive cases live; the agreement was informal and has not been added to the forum plan.

acceptance_conditions: The forum must relaunch with safeguards rather than resume under its previous structure.
A neutral facilitator must lead the first two resumed sessions.
Anonymous written questions must be accepted for exactly the first two resumed sessions.
The relaunch plan must cover exactly two initial sessions.
A commitment to collect confidential participant feedback after the second session must exist.
The decision-maker must explicitly cite the reported confidentiality breach when justifying the safeguards.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'confidential_feedback' and c['target'] == 'forum_participants' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The observed disclosure changes the forum from an ordinary restart to relaunch_with_safeguards and changes facilitation from the existing chair to a neutral facilitator.
The informal agreement changes anonymous_questions_enabled to True for exactly 2 sessions, fixes the initial relaunch at exactly 2 sessions, and requires confidential feedback after those sessions.
